#!/bin/sh
# Nightly log backup. Bundles logs/ into a dated tarball and copies it remotely.
set -eu

DEST="backup-srv:/srv/nightly"
STAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d)
BUNDLE="logs-$STAMP.tar.gz"

tar -czf "$BUNDLE" logs/
scp "$BUNDLE" "$DEST/"
echo "wrote $BUNDLE and copied it to $DEST/"
